index: 100 = the average of the sampled months for that tier

tiers.label: Luxury resort (Maui County luxury class, STR)
tiers.unit: USD per room night (average daily rate)
tiers.basis: official monthly, STR data published by the Hawaii Tourism Authority / DBEDT, 2025
tiers.note: Luxury-class hotels on Maui, mostly Wailea, Kaanapali and Kapalua resorts.

tiers.label: Mid-range resort (Maui County upper upscale and upscale, STR)
tiers.unit: USD per room night (average daily rate)
tiers.basis: official monthly, STR data published by the Hawaii Tourism Authority / DBEDT, 2025
tiers.note: Upper-upscale and upscale hotels on Maui.

tiers.label: Budget hotel (Hawaii statewide midscale and economy, STR; Maui has too few for its own figure)
tiers.unit: USD per room night (average daily rate)
tiers.basis: official monthly, STR data published by the Hawaii Tourism Authority / DBEDT, 2025
tiers.note: Statewide, not Maui: STR notes samples for some classes and regions were too small to publish.

composite.label: All Maui County hotels
composite.basis: official monthly, STR data published by the Hawaii Tourism Authority / DBEDT, 2025 (all Maui County hotels)

notBuilt: city budget hotel (Maui has no city)

spikes.what: December peak (holidays): luxury ADR $1,387 against $737 in September

caveats: August 2025 report could not be read (its text is scrambled in the PDF); August is the average of July and September and is marked estimated.
Maui demand and prices are still shaped by the August 2023 wildfires, so 2025 may not be a typical year.
sources: Hawaii Tourism Authority / DBEDT monthly Hawaii Hotel Performance reports, January to December 2025 (files.hawaii.gov/dbedt/economic/tourism/hotel-performance/), compiled by STR

composite.label: All sampled Kyoto City hotels (about 110 to 118 hotels, DMO Kyoto)
composite.unit: JPY per room night, excluding taxes
composite.basis: official monthly (Kyoto City Tourism Association): January to July from the 2026 reports restated to 2025 using each month's year-on-year change; August to November 2025 as reported by Travel Voice quoting the same association

spikes.what: Early October (China National Day and Mid-Autumn): booking-site average selling prices above 50,000 yen against a 24,859 yen hotel ADR for the month
Cherry blossom: April 2026 hotel ADR 31,296 yen was a record since 2014 and about 1.8 times August

caveats: December 2025 could not be found (no published actual).
The report does not split by hotel class, so luxury and budget cannot be separated.
A search snippet gave April 2026 as 26,633 yen; the report page itself says 31,296 yen. I used the page.
sources: Kyoto City Tourism Association monthly data reports (kyokanko.or.jp/report/hotelYYYYMM/en), January to July 2026
Travel Voice (travelvoice.jp/english) on the August to November 2025 reports

composite.label: All Paris hotels (CoStar, preliminary)
composite.basis: official monthly, CoStar press releases (3 months only)

aggregators.what: Skyscanner Paris pages: 3-star average about 264 EUR, 4-star about 349 EUR; cheapest month February (about 273 EUR); most expensive September or November on different pages

spikes.what: New Year's Eve night: ADR 586 EUR against 372 EUR for December
June 2025 record month: two large concerts, Eurostatory trade fair and Fashion Week pushed occupancy to 86% and ADR to 514 EUR

caveats: Only January, June and December were found. CoStar's free press releases do not cover every month, and its star-class split is not public.
The star-class figures found (Lighthouse) are for France as a whole, not Paris.
sources: CoStar press releases "Mix of events drove Paris room rates to January high" and "...to all-time high" (June), "Paris hotel performance reached December high"

tiers.label: One central Reykjavik hotel, published offer rates (double room, ISK per night)
tiers.basis: rate card, one hotel (offer page; October 2025 to May 2026)
tiers.note: Summer (June to September) not on the offer page, so the highest part of the year is missing.

demand.label: Capital-region hotel occupancy (Statistics Iceland via the Icelandic Tourist Board)
demand.note: Occupancy, not price: it shows the summer peak and the winter trough but is not a price series.

aggregators.what: HotelsCombined: cheapest April (107 EUR), dearest July (417 EUR); another aggregator: cheapest April 195 EUR, dearest August 460 EUR; Kayak: low season January, high season August
aggregators.confidence: low, pages disagree on the months and the price levels differ several times over

caveats: No official monthly price series was found; Statistics Iceland publishes occupancy, not room rates.
sources: Hotel Alda Reykjavik offer page (Iceland Hotel Collection)
Statistics Iceland and Icelandic Tourist Board occupancy releases

statements.what: Shoulder months (late June, early September) priced at roughly 60 to 70% of peak; May and September rates 30 to 50% below August
The same luxury suite can cost two to three times more in August than in May
Nearly all hotels close from November to March, so low-season prices barely exist
Short-term rental average daily rate in Santorini: 388 EUR (July 2024) and 365 EUR (July 2025); not hotels

caveats: No monthly hotel price series of any kind was found for Santorini (STR and SETE data are paid).
sources: Search results only: travel guides and aggregator pages
